The '''NA LCS 2015 Spring Split''' was the fifth split of the [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]], organized by Riot Games. The season took place from January 24 to April 19, 2015, with all matches hosted at the Riot Games Studio in Los Angeles, United States. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Best-of-One format during the regular season, with the top six teams advancing to a Single Elimination Best-of-Five Playoff. The split featured a total prize pool of $100,000 USD, and the winner earned a place at the [[MSI 2015|2015 Mid-Season Invitational]].

Ahead of the season, the [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]] expanded from eight to ten teams, marking the first structural change in league history. To determine the two new participants, Riot Games hosted the [[LCS/North_America/2015/Spring/Expansion|NA LCS 2015 Spring Expansion Tournament]], where [[Curse Academy]] and [[Team Coast]] qualified for the main league. Additionally, [[Counter Logic Gaming]] and [[Team 8]] retained their spots through the [[LCS/North_America/2015/Spring/Promotion|2015 Spring Promotion Tournament]].

Before the start of the season, several organizational and roster changes took place. [[Team Impulse]] acquired the roster and spot of [[LMQ]], while [[Team Liquid]] took over the former [[Team Curse]] roster. [[Winterfox]] replaced [[Evil Geniuses]], and [[Gravity Gaming]] rebranded from [[Curse Academy]].
